tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "---INITIAL---"; head -5 data/initial_export.csv; echo "---NEW---"; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "---COUNTS---"; wc -l data/initial_export.csv data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1

hops fg create customersd3edd8 --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string,name:string,balance_eur:double,updated_at:bigint" --description "Customers initial export" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert customersd3edd8 --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25

hops fg create customersd3edd8 --version 2 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --online --features "row_id:string,full_name:string,balance:double,currency:string,updated_at:bigint" --description "Customers full reload (new schema, online enabled)" --json 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Create feature group version 2 with online enabled

tool_input.command: hops fg insert customersd3edd8 --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -12

echo "===INFO==="; hops fg info customersd3edd8 --version 2 --json 2>&1 | grep -iE '"(name|version|online|primary|event)' ; echo "===PREVIEW==="; hops fg preview customersd3edd8 --version 2 --n 3 --json 2>&1 | tail -30
